description:
What if Claude AI could edit an entire documentary for you? No CapCut, no After Effects, no complicated editing software!

In this video, I'll show you how to create professional documentary-style videos using Claude AI and my FREE custom plugin, **Kaz Documentary**.

I spent over 5 hours developing and refining this documentary workflow, and instead of selling it, I'm sharing it with you completely FREE!

For this tutorial, we're creating a historical documentary called "How One Assassination Sparked World War I" using real historical images, AI voiceovers, vintage-style 2D animations, and Claude AI.

🔥 **What You'll Learn:**
- How to create documentary videos with Claude AI
- How to find real historical images for your videos
- How to prepare your script, images, and voiceover
- How to install and use my FREE Kaz Documentary plugin
- How Claude automatically edits documentary videos
- How to add vintage-style 2D animations
- How to create documentaries without CapCut or After Effects

🎁 **FREE Resources:**

📥 Kaz Documentary Plugin:https://drive.google.com/file/d/1raczBx8FF6svGF29mjIvTmwg3y0SiUgM/view?usp=sharing
🎙️ Try ElevenLabs: https://try.elevenlabs.io/axy9kpsgs2if

🤖 Claude AI: https://claude.ai

You can use this workflow for different documentary niches, including history, science, mysteries, true crime, and educational content.

I'm also working on another brand-new Claude AI animation style, so make sure you're subscribed and turn on notifications!

👍 Like this video if you found it helpful.

💬 Comment below: What documentary niche are you planning to try?
